name: Stealing the Undercity's Flame
label: Quest
description: Stealing the Undercity's Flame: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This flame, stolen from the ruins above the Undercity, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...

clips.title: Progress
paras: You're practically glowing, traveler. What do you have there?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hm... What a strange fire! It is subdued, nearly smoldering, but the heat is intense. And you received this from the Undercity, you say? Fascinating. With the flames of all three cities, who knows what we could accomplish?
